title: Urgent: Private deployment RBAC session mapping + KMS rotation gaps causing secret access failures
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Multiple customer escalations in the last 48 hours for Private deployments: (1) SAML session attributes intermittently dropped during IdP re-auth, causing RBAC role mapping to fall back to 'workspace-user' and allowing elevated token reuse; (2) during scheduled KMS key rotation, some HSM-backed KMS providers returned transient decrypt errors which were swallowed by the runtime and not emitted to audit logs, leaving several workspace secret fetches to silently fail. This ticket tracks investigation, mitigation, patch rollout, and customer communication.
steps_to_reproduce: Deploy a private control plane with SAML IdP that sends session attributes with nameID and roles
Create two role mappings: 'admin' and 'workspace-user' with attribute-based mapping rules
Force IdP re-auth (short session TTL) and attempt to list workspace secrets; observe intermittent 403s and fallback to workspace-user role

Trigger KMS key rotation on HSM provider with key version bump; attempt to decrypt existing secrets while rotation is in progress and observe DecryptError logged client-side but not forwarded to audit pipeline
steps_taken: 2026-03-10 03:20 UTC: On-call (Ava) triaged first CS ticket CS-2894, created rate-limited mitigation by pinning affected workspaces to older KMS key version
2026-03-10 06:45 UTC: Reproduced RBAC mapping drop locally using SAML stub; confirmed session parsing race between SAML assertion processing and session-store renewal
2026-03-11 00:10 UTC: Implemented temporary runtime gating to reject session renewals without role attributes; pushed gate to canary groups in two private clusters (PR #4512)
2026-03-11 14:00 UTC: Added explicit audit log emission for KMS decrypt failures; wired to audit-stream in staging to verify visibility (PR #4520)
2026-03-12 09:30 UTC: Security review with Omar Khan; agreed to full patch with unit tests and an e2e against partner HSM emulator
2026-03-13 20:15 UTC: Patch validated in staging with customer-like workload; observed no silent decrypt failures and role mapping remained stable under forced re-auth
activity: 2026-03-10: Customer CS-2894 escalated to SEs after repeated secret fetch failures during a key rotation window
2026-03-11: Engineering hotfix pushed to canary; identified root cause for RBAC: race in session renewal handler that replaced attributes with empty map when IdP returned NextAuth reference header
2026-03-12: Added audit emissions for KMS errors; discovered HSM client returned 503-like transient errors without descriptive code and runtime mistakenly treated these as successful no-op
2026-03-13: PM Lina Patel approved customer comms draft; on-call to run targeted patch rollout to remaining private clusters tonight
2026-03-14: Security confirmed acceptance criteria for release; planned postmortem and retrospective tasks created
acceptance_criteria: RBAC session mapping race fixed: re-auth path preserves role attributes across session renewal in all supported SAML IdPs
KMS decrypt errors surface to audit logs and the runtime surfaces a deterministic retry or fail-path with clear error codes
Patch passes unit tests, integration tests with HSM emulator, and canary rollout for 24h with synthetic and production-like traffic
Customer workspaces affected by CS-2894 either auto-recovered or received an opt-in remediation run and had a support message sent
resolution_summary: Two root causes: a session renewal race that caused role attributes to be dropped (fixed by atomic session replace and added assertion validation) and a KMS error-handling gap where transient HSM errors were suppressed (fixed by explicit error bubbling and audit emission). Hotfixes merged (PRs 4512, 4520). Canary rollout completed; now preparing full rollout and customer remediation run.
rollback_plan: If new runtime introduces regressions, revert PR #4512 and #4520 and re-enable previous audit hooks
Notify customers of temporary degraded behavior and provide manual remediation steps to pin key versions or switch to provider fallbacks
Open follow-up patch with improved test coverage before reattempting rollout
communication: 2026-03-11 18:00 UTC: Sent initial incident message to affected customers via support with mitigation steps
2026-03-13 09:00 UTC: PM Lina Patel sent follow-up with expected timeline for full rollout and contact window
2026-03-14 08:15 UTC: Release notes and post-deployment checklist published to customer portal
postmortem_tasks: Run formal postmortem within 7 days and publish on Confluence
Expand e2e tests to cover SAML IdP re-auth and KMS rotation scenarios across supported HSMs
Add metrics and alerts for dropped attributes and any audit emission failures
Track a follow-up project to harden KMS client retry semantics (ENG-6420)
notes: Security sign-off required before full rollout; interim canary gating allowed per policy
Consider backporting patch to private-2026.02 branch for customers on older control plane versions
Work with Solutions Engineering to schedule remediation windows for the three highest-impacted customers
